QuestInfo.name: Keol's Order #6
QuestInfo.0: Keol, the pompous working partner of Moren who is as irritable as they come in all of Maple, is giving me a new work request. Better go see what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Moren's coworker Keol received a request from General Maestro of Omega Sector to build a Water Gun for Training, and asked me to do it for him. I better put extra effort into this, since this directly affects the performance of the soldiers.\n\n#i4001179# #t4001179# #b#c4001179# / 7
QuestInfo.2: Moren's coworker Keol received a request from General Maestro of Omega Sector to build a Water Gun for Training, and asked me to do it for him. For someone that does not trust my item-producing skills, he keeps asking me to make one for him. What's the deal with him, anyway?

0.0: As an item-producer, nothing is more important than trust. Remember the request from Manager Karl of Ludibrium last time? Apparently he told people around him about our work, because we received a new order. This time, it's from General Maestro of the Omega Sector. He asked us to create a number of weapons.
0.1: We received such a huge order that I want to give the easiest ones to you. Are you ready for it? That's because Ramain will be working on communication devices, Moren will be working on secret op devices, and I will be working on Meso Ranger uniforms, so we're totally unavailable right now.

yes.0: Here's the purchase order. #b#t4001179##k will be used for new trainees of Omega Sector, so be extra careful on the security side of the weapons. You know the rest, right? You'll need to make #b7#k of those.

no.0: This is the kind of opportunity that doesn't come often. That being said, there's no point of giving it to you if you don't recognize it. There are plenty of nobodies that Moren brought that can make these.

1.0: You finally brought them. We just received a call from Omega Sector saying that if these guns do not pass the safety test, then they'll return them for a full refund, so you better stay on your toes.

item.0: You know you don't have much time left until the deadline, right? You don't have time to wander around doing other things! Making #b7 #t4001179#s#k is not an easy task by any means.

lost.0: This is preposterous. Unbelievable. How can you not even take care of the purchase order I gave you? What was Moren thinking? Seriously, un-be-lieeevable.
